theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have h₁ : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ↔ Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro hA hAᶜ
      have h₂ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by ext x; simp
      have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAᶜ
      rw [h₂] at h₃; exact h₃
    · intro hA
      by_contra h
      have h₂ : A ∉ P := h.1
      have h₃ : ∀ U ∈ P, A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := by
        intro U hU; exact hPP U hU A h₂
      exact hPS ⟨A, h₂, h₃⟩
  have h₂ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card \ P.card = P.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    · intro A hA; simp [h₁]
    · intro A hA; simp [h₁]
    · intro A hA; simp
    · intro A hA; simp
  have h₃ : 2 * P.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₄ : P.card + (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card \ P.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_union_add_card_inter P (Finset.univ \ P)]
      simp [Finset.union_eq_univ, Finset.inter_eq_empty]
    rw [h₂] at h₄
    simp [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set] at h₄
    linarith
  have h₄ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by positivity
  calc
    P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
      rw [← Nat.div_eq_of_eq_mul_right (by norm_num : 0 < 2) h₃]
      rw [← pow_add]
      simp [h₄]
    _ = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := rfl
